mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an ultra-loose monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 0.07% as of t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 6.8 and PAYEMS > 137000.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Industrial production at 101.0251 as of t-2mo
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 900 thousand (HOUST > 900) signals strong residential construction, boosting related industries and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Housing starts at 880.0 as of t-2mo
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer spending and housing market activity, fueling corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 425000 and HOUST > 880.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) signals the Federal Reserve's likelihood to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.
